lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hey, Hyunju! How was your day off? What did you do today?
lines.ko: 현주야! 쉬는 날 어땠어? 오늘 뭐 했어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Today I went to the photo gallery to see a Martin Parr exhibition, and I rode a bike for sixteen kilometers. It was really good.
lines.ko: 오늘 사진 미술관에 마틴 파 전시를 보러 갔고, 자전거도 16킬로미터 탔어. 정말 좋았어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, Martin Parr! His photos are so colorful. What did you like the most?
lines.ko: 와, 마틴 파! 사진 색감이 정말 화려하잖아. 뭐가 제일 좋았어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It was my first time seeing his photos. His photos tell many stories without words. They were very impressive.
lines.ko: 그 사람 사진은 처음 봤어. 말이 없어도 사진에 이야기가 정말 많이 담겨 있어. 정말 인상적이었어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: "Stories without words." I love that! Which photo do you remember the most?
lines.ko: "말 없는 이야기"라니, 표현 좋다! 어떤 사진이 제일 기억나?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I like most of his photos, but especially the photos from North Korea.
lines.ko: 사진 대부분이 좋았는데, 특히 북한에서 찍은 사진들이 좋았어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Photos of North Korea? That sounds really interesting! What were they like?
lines.ko: 북한 사진? 정말 흥미롭다! 어떤 사진이었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: People in those photos look very similar to me, but their faces tell so many stories.
lines.ko: 사진 속 사람들이 나랑 정말 비슷하게 생겼는데, 얼굴에 이야기가 정말 많이 담겨 있어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: That sounds very moving. And then you rode a bike for sixteen kilometers? Where did you go?
lines.ko: 정말 감동적이었겠다. 그러고 나서 자전거를 16킬로미터나 탔다고? 어디로 갔어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I started near the gallery. I planned to ride ten kilometers, but I couldn't stop!
lines.ko: 미술관 근처에서 출발했어. 10킬로미터만 타려고 했는데, 멈출 수가 없더라!

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Ha ha! You couldn't stop? You must have really enjoyed it! Aren't your legs tired?
lines.ko: 하하! 멈출 수가 없었다고? 진짜 재밌었나 보다! 다리 안 아파?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No! Surprisingly, my legs aren't tired. If it hadn't gotten dark, I would have ridden twenty kilometers.
lines.ko: 응! 놀랍게도 다리가 하나도 안 아파. 날이 어두워지지만 않았으면 20킬로미터는 탔을 거야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, you're so strong now! Let's ride bikes together next time. Have a good night, Hyunju!
lines.ko: 와, 이제 체력 정말 좋아졌네! 다음엔 같이 자전거 타자. 잘 자, 현주야!
